Stocky bandage-wrapped upper hindquarters and shoulders, small mottled reddish-brown head, weathered dirty ochre and brown bandages, dark canine distal legs and slim toes. Low, still, wary quadruped bracing stance facing strictly RIGHT, with the level camera looking directly at the side of its ribcage. The chin projects horizontally far forward at shoulder height, muzzle modestly parted and the crease between its halves readable; no gore or streaming effects. The front half sinks closer to the ground, the elbows bend outward and both forepaws plant in front of the chest in a staggered low brace. The high rounded wrapped haunches remain behind on the left, hocks flexed and the rear paws firmly planted below the rump. Distinguish all four legs, keep the far forepaw just behind the nearer forepaw, preserve the continuous belly line. It has paused after approaching, weight distributed across four grounded paws. The posture must be materially different from the model reference’s high airborne running stride with a raised forepaw: here all four paws touch a single implied ground plane and the neck is extended low forward. Native right-facing body, broad profile silhouette, wider than tall; show single cleft muzzle clearly, do not add a tail or horns. One complete isolated figure on true transparent alpha with generous margin around every toe, snout, ear region and haunch.
